description: This file contains unit tests for the Notes module in the SuiteCRM project, utilizing the PHPUnit framework. It tests note object creation, attribute validation, attachment handling, deletion, summary text generation, export query creation, additional fields filling, list view data retrieval, ACL helper, and bean interface implementation.

classes.name: NoteTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the Notes module functionalities in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, including creating a new User bean as the current user.

methods.name: testNote
methods.description: Tests the constructor of the Note bean for correct instantiation and attribute values.

methods.name: testsafeAttachmentName
methods.description: Validates the safeAttachmentName method with valid and invalid filenames.

methods.name: testmark_deleted
methods.description: Ensures that the mark_deleted method executes without exception.

methods.name: testdeleteAttachment
methods.description: Checks that deleteAttachment returns true for a Note with an assigned id.

methods.name: testget_summary_text
methods.description: Verifies get_summary_text returns empty when name is unset and returns the name when set.

methods.name: testcreate_export_query
methods.description: Tests generate export SQL queries with empty and specific parameters.

methods.name: testfill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Checks that fill_in_additional_list_fields executes without errors.

methods.name: testfill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Checks that fill_in_additional_detail_fields executes without errors.

methods.name: testget_list_view_data
methods.description: Validates that get_list_view_data returns the expected associative array based on the Note's properties.

methods.name: testlistviewACLHelper
methods.description: Ensures listviewACLHelper returns the correct permissions array.

methods.name: testbean_implements
methods.description: Tests the bean_implements method with various inputs to confirm ACL support.
